content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new here and I'm trying to use an older [product_name] to control my KOI pond. The module I own is a 230RCL from the older [article_no] series if I'm correct. I'm operating with Windows 7. I purchased a cable from a reputable online seller, following the [company_name] part number, manufactured by Link Technology Corp. I'm using [product_name] V6.x, but every time I try connecting to the module, I get a timeout error. The driver seems installed properly, and the cable's box lights up when I change the module's mode. Setting up the driver was challenging, but eventually I managed.

Hello, The current version of [product_name] doesn't support Windows 7. There are some solutions shared on this forum. You can try getting the latest driver for the USB cable from the internet. Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't. Waiting for [product_name] V7 might be the best choice. Hope this helps.

By LSC, do you mean the [product_name] cable? Windows 7 reports that the cable works fine, so should I ignore that and buy a new, more expensive cable? I appreciate your patience since I'm new and not yet familiar with all the technical details.
Hi, I believe [user_name] meant that 'LSC' refers to [product_name] (the software). Best regards, [user_name]

Thank you for clarifying. So the issue is with the software? The USB cable driver seems to install correctly, and the software works except for the actual communication with the module. I even tried running it inside a virtual machine, but that didn't help (at least with the USB cable). I'm wondering if it would work with a serial cable, and would appreciate any advice from someone who has tried this. To recap: [product_name] version 7 will be available soon? How soon? A week, month, or year? The information I've found indicates that [company_name] continues relying on older XP software, which makes me question my choice—I’m thinking I should have gone with a different manufacturer.
So far, [company_name] is indicating that the new version will be released this month.

Thanks for the update. I just hope the upgrade won't require an additional payment, since it's common practice with most other software vendors. This issue arose only because I'm using Windows 7 on my new computer.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are facing major connectivity problems between [product_name] and older hardware when running on unsupported operating systems such as Windows 7. Despite successful driver installation, communication failures persist, leading to timeouts. Users are frustrated by the lack of support for recent OS versions, which creates concerns about having to unnecessarily purchase new hardware or incur additional upgrade costs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect both the programming software and its hardware to operate reliably on current operating systems like Windows 7. They hope for seamless communication, timely software updates, and free upgrades to maintain compatibility.
